name: undo snapshots only the clips again
guards: the target length and the programme name are inside undo
expect: holds the length being worked to

name: a new edit no longer closes the redo branch
guards: redo means putting back what was just taken away
find:
never followed from this state.
  redoStack.length = 0;
replace:
never followed from this state.
  void 0;

name: stepping forward does not refill the undo stack
guards: redo can itself be undone

name: reorder stops validating the index it is handed
guards: a stray drag cannot splice at NaN
expect: moves on a real pair of positions

name: trims are no longer clamped to the file that arrives
guards: a programme cannot claim time the audio does not have

name: the clock rounds after splitting the minutes off
guards: 59.98 seconds is not shown as 0:60.0
replace:
const m = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
  const s = seconds - m * 60;

name: a low sample rate stops affecting the verdict
guards: a 320k rip of a 22 kHz source is not called good
expect: low sample rate pulls the verdict down

name: a swapped song is accepted without comment
guards: a different song with the same name is not built into the programme
expect: not the one it was built from

name: the project stops recording what its songs were
guards: a project can tell whether it has the right music

name: every reconnect failure gives the same message
guards: each way of failing says what to do about it

name: the fingerprint ignores the order of the bytes
guards: two files with the same bytes rearranged are not the same file

name: remembering files stops being optional
guards: browsers without the API keep working exactly as before
expect: falls back to the file picker

name: the reconnect button is offered for files nothing remembers
guards: only songs that can actually come back are offered
expect: offered back instead of a picker

name: the colour cache is bypassed
guards: drawing does not force a style resolve every frame

name: the timeline is rebuilt on every call
guards: dragging a slider does not churn the DOM

name: the library is rebuilt on every refresh
guards: an idle refresh costs nothing

name: waveforms are drawn per event rather than per frame
guards: drawing coalesces to one batch a frame

name: the blend marker is dropped from the timeline signature
guards: a change of structure hiding inside a change of number
find: parts[i].xf >= MIN_CROSSFADE ? 1 : 0,      // whether a blend marker is shown

name: a theme change trusts the stale colour cache
guards: switching theme repaints the canvases

name: the audition bypasses its level and fade nodes
guards: what you hear is the clip as it is set

name: the busy state waits only on a frame
guards: a hidden tab does not deadlock the analysis buttons

name: the drop handler reads text/plain again
guards: a stray drop cannot reorder the programme

name: an open dialog stops owning the keyboard
guards: editing keys do not reach the programme behind a dialog

name: the export clipping guard is removed
guards: a distorted programme is caught before it is encoded

name: Ctrl+Y stops redoing
guards: both redo shortcuts work

name: typing a name pushes an undo step per keystroke
guards: a typed name is one undo step
expect: one undo step, not one per letter

name: a drop on the timeline no longer adds the song
guards: dropping on the strip puts the music in the programme
find: if (ontoTimeline) for (const entry of added) addClip(entry);
expect: puts the song in the programme

name: a colour is changed in the app but not the docs
guards: the guide keeps looking like the app it documents

name: the app stops linking to the guide
guards: the documentation is reachable from the app
expect: no longer links to the guide

name: an explicit light choice stops beating the system
guards: the toggle works in both directions, not just towards dark

name: the theme choice is not remembered
guards: the theme survives a reload
find: try { localStorage.setItem(THEME_KEY, mode); } catch (_) { /* private mode */ }

name: collapsing the sidebar takes every panel header with it
guards: only the music panel's own header goes

name: the collapsed sidebar keeps its column
guards: collapsing actually gives the workspace the room

name: forgetting clears storage before the refresh puts it back
guards: nothing is left behind after forgetting
find:
try { localStorage.removeItem(STORE_KEY); } catch (_) { /* private mode */ }
  describeStored();

guards: an emptied programme is not reported as work
find: if (clips) parts.push('the programme you are working on');
replace: if (true) parts.push('the programme you are working on');

name: a click outside stops closing the settings menu
guards: the menu does not stay open over the page
